title: Payment API Database Connection Timeout during Batch Reporting
symptoms: Postgres connection timeouts across all API clients
p99 latency spiked to 6.8s on primary read/write node
observations: pg_stat_activity shows long-running sequential scan query on ledger_transactions table
Worker processes have NO socket leaks
evidence: pg_stat_activity confirmed sequential scan on 14M rows in ledger_transactions
Worker connection pool was healthy; timeouts were caused by database server latency
verification: p99 latency returned to 45ms and connection backlog cleared
root_cause: Database CPU and I/O overload caused by unindexed analytical reporting query executing against primary database replica.
resolution: Terminated blocking query PID 44102, added index on ledger_transactions(merchant_id, created_at), and redirected reporting queries to read replica.

timeline.event: Incident INC-REAL-02 recorded for Payment API
